title: Honorlock's AI Proctoring System Reportedly Led Broward College to Accuse a Teenager of Cheating

behaviors.text: During a February 2022 online biology exam, Honorlock reportedly flagged a Florida teenager taking a Broward College class as suspicious.
The [person] denied cheating, but Broward College allegedly relied on the remote-proctoring system's flag in pursuing an academic-dishonesty accusation that the [person] said was unfounded.
